name: io.github.cnkang/qdrant-memory
title: Qdrant Memory
description: Persistent scoped Qdrant memory for agents, through four explicit stdio MCP tools.

packageArguments.name: --home
packageArguments.description: Optional absolute path to an operator-configured, initialized profile; omission uses ~/.qdrant-memory.

environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional remote Qdrant endpoint when configured for server/cloud mode.

environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Qdrant credential for configured remote storage.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional credential for the configured embedding provider.
